page_title: TOT 1-2 IPS | Tottenham Hotspur v Ipswich 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The expression of the referee Darren England is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) is shown a yellow card.
90+6' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Arijanet Muric. What a save!
90+4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Ipswich.
90+3' Yellow card. Leif Davis (Ipswich) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90+2' Kieran McKenna has decided to make a change. Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) replaces Jens Cajuste.
90+1' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
88' The corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric.
87' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
86' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
84' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Brennan Johnson and he is replaced by James Maddison (Tottenham).
84' Substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur will be replaced by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).
80' George Hirst (Ipswich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) was probably a bit loose with his words to Darren England, who decides to show him a yellow.
78' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
78' Timo Werner (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

74' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
74' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

72' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
72' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

72' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sammie Szmodics trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jack Clarke (Ipswich).
70' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Liam Delap is replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).

69' 1 - 2 Goal! Pedro Porro launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went into the top right corner. It's 1:2.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will take a corner kick.
66' That will be all from Pape Matar Sarr who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Timo Werner (Tottenham).
65' Darren England shows the yellow card to Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) for a heavy challenge.
65' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) serves up a nice cross, but Guglielmo Vicario punches the ball away.
64' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
64' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
62' The game is interrupted now, Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

62' That's unlucky! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
62' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
62' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Tottenham, play can continue.

61' Play continues despite the shouts by some Tottenham players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Darren England interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
61' Surely that's handball by one of the Ipswich players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

60' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
59' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.

58' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
57' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Leif Davis (Ipswich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
56' Tottenham are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Ipswich).
52' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
51' Celebrations are cut short for Tottenham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
50' Wait! Referee Darren England has indicated he is going to review the Tottenham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
49' Goal! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:2.
49' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play and Tottenham manage to earn a corner.
49' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Arijanet Muric has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
46' Darren England shows a yellow card to Liam Delap (Ipswich) for a tough tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+4' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Liam Delap (Ipswich) and blew his whistle.
45+2' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 2 Goal! Liam Delap (Ipswich) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
42' Leif Davis (Ipswich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
41' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
39' Darren England blows his whistle and it's Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
37' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) meets a cross inside the box, but Arijanet Muric wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
35' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
33' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' 0 - 1 GOOOOOAL! Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) finds space in the box from the lofted pass and lands the perfect scissor-kick goal. G.O.A.T? Probably not, but it’s 0:1.
31' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and Darren England interrupts the game.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
28' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
27' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).
24' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
23' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
23' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) gets a yellow card. The referee Darren England made the right call.
20' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
20' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

20' A sweet pass finds Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Arijanet Muric is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
19' The game is interrupted. Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
18' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' 72:28 – the ratio of ball possession.
12' A pass by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
11' What an amazing save by Arijanet Muric! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but fails.
11' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

11' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
9' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
9' Ipswich get a corner.
9' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
7' Tottenham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
4' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
3' The foul by Liam Delap (Ipswich) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' The resulting corner from Leif Davis (Ipswich) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

2' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario pulls off a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Ipswich.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Darren England.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
